coordinate_system.up: map north = UE +X; no geographic north asserted

scope.continuity: Resume actors at their actual +90 states concurrently with the already-approved civilian +90–105 knots. No civilian knot shifts earlier and nobody receives an extra fifteen metres/seconds. Step 3 actor freeze is a review reference only. Explicit already-chosen movement continues at most four more seconds. Impact is +108; by +109 local sound/impact can register, without a new civilian decision.
scope.stop_reason: Blood strikes at +108; stop at +109 after immediate impact/sound reception, before choosing new civilian reactions. Do not wait until +125/+135 to force a barrier demonstration or another attack.

witch.reaction_to_civilians: Ignores M04 while continuing to the Mayor; no explanatory dialogue, help, diversion or stop.

information_policy.direct: Working plan-view witnesses identified separately from exposure and possible distant sight. Lighting/attention not raycast.
information_policy.sound: Local impact likely within45 m and possible distant sound within85 m are schematic listening ranges, not exact acoustics; walls/interior noise reduce recognition.
information_policy.no_relay: No new civilian warning journeys or verbal propagation are simulated after events. New information is only direct receipt, and no new decisions are made.

post_action_concentrations.description: Two newly injured arriving helpers remain at the eastern fringe; no new rescuers have chosen to join.
Supported injured person and helper continue just beyond the sweep; separate from H01 despite proximity.
Original western limping-person/escort pocket remains alive and separate.

pending_bone_stimuli.description: New heavy crash from centre at +108 may be heard; not automatic exact knowledge or a chosen redirection.
The same living parent/child after the deliberate coop hit; their next reaction is unassigned.
Smith/apprentice may now understand a nearby precision threat; no next shout/run/closure has been authored.

assumptions: Injury/fatality outcomes are provisional physical exposure judgements, not calibrated damage/health mechanics. No count was chosen before the physical envelope and movements.
The wave is a broad provisional envelope, not an exact final ability. Its central and outer-force zones explain different exposure without aiming surgically at individuals.

Short-range cries/movement and existing practical light support local monster attention; no new global sensing or innate darkvision power is assumed. Exact lighting and visibility still need scene checks.

M04 keeps the same appeal intent and tiny road-edge step. The Witch is already walking away, so Step 3 distance to her at +105 was only a frozen-reference measurement and is superseded by this concurrent pass.
The functional bell is now canon for the healthy village, but its operating access is unresolved in the supplied map. No ringing or bell reception is fabricated.

Most civilian last-resolved poses stay as the previous activity or pending threshold/route continuation. Only explicitly listed motions advance four seconds; no unplanned door, street choice or full flight is invented.

Bone intentionally hits existing coop timber beside M05. An apparent near-miss is deliberate; neither member of M05 is injured. This follows his existing torment interest rather than selecting a body count.
The clean stop is +109, one second after Blood impact. Barrier contacts remain future possibilities, not scheduled guaranteed deaths. Do not extend this pass solely to demonstrate the weapon.

next_reaction_handoff.civilian_records: Use reception records for counts/positions and T2 for unchanged intent; casualties override living status. Do not add event/group counts twice.
